ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Another impediment is that this research is pushing in many directions, based on data sources but without integrating the new-found knowledge into overall accounts of the role of media in social change. Big data is at the leading edge of the rapidly advancing research front in the social sciences, and especially in communication research. ( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from commercial media platforms. ( ) And most of this knowledge is not being produced within the social sciences at all, but rather in the private sector and to a lesser extent in policy settings. ( ) This knowledge can be yoked to aims such as marketing, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater accuracy. ( ) More powerful knowledge thus plays a role in everyday life, but it remains largely invisible, as when digital media users are unaware of how information is filtered for them. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② comes → come: 선행사 'the sources of data'(복수)를 받는 which이므로 복수 동사 come
det.analysis:
✅ ① integrating: 'without integrating' — 전치사 + 동명사, 적절
❌ ② comes → come: which의 선행사는 sources(복수). 복수 주어에 단수 동사 comes는 수일치 오류 ←정답
✅ ③ yoked: 'can be yoked to' — 조동사 + be + p.p. 수동태, 적절
✅ ④ unaware: 'users are unaware of' — 형용사 보어, 적절
det.tip: 관계대명사 which의 동사 수는 선행사에 일치. sources(복수) → come

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ as → such as: 예시를 나열할 때 'such as'가 올바른 표현
det.analysis:
✅ ① based: 분사구문(~에 기초하여), 적절
✅ ② how: 간접의문문(어떻게 필터링되는지), 적절
❌ ③ as → such as: 원문은 'such as privacy'. 'as privacy'는 '프라이버시로서'라는 다른 의미 ←정답
✅ ④ in which: 전치사+관계대명사, 적절
det.tip: such as = ~와 같은 (예시). as = ~로서 (자격)

questions.passage: Another impediment is that this research is pushing in many directions, based on data sources but without integrating the new-found knowledge into overall accounts of the role of media in social change. Big data is at the leading edge of the rapidly advancing research front in the social sciences, and especially in communication research. ( ) But this research is partly limited by the sources of data, which often, though not always, come from commercial media platforms. ( ) And most of this knowledge is not being produced within the social sciences at all, but rather in the private sector and to a lesser extent in policy settings. ( ) This knowledge can be <u>yoked to aims such as marketing</u>, targeting populations and tailoring messages to individuals with greater accuracy. ( ) More powerful knowledge thus plays a role in everyday life, but it remains largely invisible, as when digital media users are unaware of how information is filtered for them. ( ) Big data raises certain issues in new guises, such as privacy, but the public is also adapting to the ways in which media uses are being utilized for advertising and marketing.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>yoked to aims such as marketing</u>이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean:
yoked to aims such as marketing = 상업적 이익을 위한 도구로 활용될 수 있다

→ 본문: yoke(멍에)의 비유. 지식이 마케팅 같은 상업적 목적에 '종속/결합'된다는 뜻. 뒤에 targeting, tailoring 등 상업 활동이 이어짐
det.analysis:
❌ ① freely shared with the academic community (학술 커뮤니티와 자유 공유): yoke(멍에)는 자유 공유가 아닌 종속을 함의
❌ ② restricted from being used by the general public (일반 대중 사용 제한): 접근 제한이 아닌 활용 방향의 문제
✅ ③ harnessed as a tool for commercial interests (상업적 이익을 위한 도구로 활용): yoke의 비유적 의미. 지식이 상업적 목적에 종속
❌ ④ developed through collaborative scientific research (공동 과학 연구로 개발): 민간 부문에서 생산된다고 했으므로 무관
det.tip: yoke = 멍에. yoked to = ~에 종속/결합된

ch: freely shared with the academic community
restricted from being used by the general public
harnessed as a tool for commercial interests
